svg.title: How the next token is predicted
svg.desc: Left-to-right pipeline of the geometric stack: a token id selects an embedding row; sixteen layers in the pattern rrarrarrarrarrar alternate quaternion-rotation recurrence (r) with reads over earlier positions (a); a final norm gives logits over the 4,096 tokens, a softmax in the float form, and an optional copy head routed by prime products mixes in a copy distribution to give the next-token probabilities. A band notes that the served form uses integer table reads and a greedy argmax over integer scores.
svg.text: How the next token is predicted
r layer: carry the state by rotation
+ age term; softmax mixes earlier states
after every layer: SwiGLU MLP + residual
sources chosen by a learned score, or the exact prime route: gcd of prime products of the last
≤ 6 tokens vs earlier windows (or the longest n-let)
served: steps 2–6 as D11 integer table reads (no multiplier, no float); token = greedy argmax over i32 scores, no vocabulary softmax
Geometry: state carried by quaternion rotation, the past read by a Lorentz score, copying routed by primes. Float form shown.
Example numbers are illustrative. Served form: D11 integer table reads for steps 2-6, greedy argmax, no vocabulary softmax.
